wish: someone should make a tool that makes and prints game cards
spec:
Makes game cards from a form (title, text, image, copies) or a pasted list, and lays them out on A4 or Letter sheets at real card sizes.
Add cards, pick card size and paper, optionally set a card back, tap Print; cut along the dashed lines.
It does not design layouts per card or store anything off your device.
